origin: cyborg-series-2026-05-15 campaign launched with zero images — no assets/ folder, no asset.file entries in campaign.json. Instagram requires images; LinkedIn and X perform significantly better with them. No gate existed to enforce asset completeness before distribution.
description: Validates that all required image slots in campaign.json are filled and that the referenced files exist on disk. BLOCKs if Instagram spokes or Substack source lack images. WARNs if LinkedIn hub or X thread lack images.
gates: instagram_asset_required: any instagram spoke without asset.file = BLOCK
substack_asset_required: source without asset.file = BLOCK (substack cover required)
asset_file_exists: any asset.file that is specified but not on disk = BLOCK
applies_to: Pre-flight check in campaign-preflight gate pipeline
Any spoke addition that involves an image-bearing platform
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=all assets present, exit 1=blocked (missing required images), exit 2=warn (recommended images missing)
